sourceOfDecisions: Saved enterIds; reconstruct only factual state/reason from immutable ENTER/SKIP latch and input validity. Never regenerate numerical predictions.

cohortSemantics.badAdverse: Observed strict30m D30 >= 2; severe >= 5, extreme >= 10. Existing severity landmarks, diagnostic only.
cohortSemantics.relativelyLowRisk: Observed strict30m D30 < 2; not a safety or profitability claim.
cohortSemantics.opportunity: Strict30m MFE >= 1/2/3/5. A high-touch outcome, not guaranteed execution or net profit.
cohortSemantics.A: Risk-rejected and D30 >= 2, even if also an opportunity winner. Overlaps B/C intentionally.
cohortSemantics.B: Risk-rejected and 1 <= MFE < 3; overlaps A if adverse.
cohortSemantics.C: Risk-rejected and MFE >= 3; overlaps A if adverse.
cohortSemantics.D: Saved ENTER and D30 >= 2; severe/extreme reported separately.
cohortSemantics.E: Saved ENTER, MFE >= 1 and D30 < 2; not realized profitability.
cohortSemantics.F: Strict30m label unavailable, for any saved state; never a negative or zero label.
cohortSemantics.other: Low-risk low-opportunity rejects/accepts, post-ENTER latch skips, or invalid inputs are disclosed separately. A-F are not forced to be an exhaustive disjoint partition.

inputAttribution: Use saved coefficients, medians, means and scales. Compute aggregate single-input additive-term distributions by saved state/outcome group only. Never add the five components and intercept, reconstruct individual predictedD30, call fit/predict, or generate new decisions. Associations are descriptive, not ablation or causal effects.
continuousPredictionAnalysis: Unavailable: previous Development run did not serialize inner rawPrediction/predictedD30 rows. No reconstruction under this instruction.
precisionDecomposition: Saved v1/v2 ENTER intersection, v1-only and v2-only. At each opportunity level the precision difference equals removal effect + addition effect, with both denominators explicit. Separate v1-only risk rejection from an earlier v2 ENTER latch.
symbolRiskAttribution: For symbol s: sum(v1 D30_s)/N_v1 - sum(v2 D30_s)/N_v2; sums exactly to mean-D30 improvement. Composition accounting, not causal per-symbol model effect. Report positive/negative masses separately.
replication: Report each of 4 chronological and 20 symbol-exclusion inner calibration units separately. Overlapping periods and four complement-group appearances are not independent samples. No held-symbol outer predictions exist.
quantiles: Linear interpolation over observed outcome/feature values for descriptive quantiles only; never fill market bars or model features.
